title: Syronius FRAME overlay-presets.json (V1)
description: Stored overlay presets. Each preset maps to a stable OBS Browser Source URL at /overlays/view/<id>. The server injects the full preset config at render time — no query params required in OBS.

default_preset_id.description: Preset selected by default in the wizard and used as the stock starting point. The wizard must ensure this ID exists in presets.

css_color.description: Any valid CSS color string: hex (#e8f0ff), rgba(0,0,0,0.3), hsl(220,80%,60%), named. Wizard must supply valid CSS; schema accepts any string.

dock_position.description: Anchor point on the OBS canvas. tl=top-left, t=top-center, tr=top-right, l=mid-left, c=center, r=mid-right, bl=bottom-left, b=bottom-center, br=bottom-right. The server translates this into CSS position properties.

layout.description: Placement of the overlay widget on the OBS canvas.

pad.description: Pixel offset from the edges implied by dock. e.g. dock=br + pad=20 → bottom:20px; right:20px. Edge-centered positions (t, b, l, r) apply pad to one axis; c ignores pad.

scale.description: CSS scale() transform applied to the widget root. Does not affect the OBS source canvas size.

width_px.description: Overlay card width in pixels. 0 uses automatic content width.

height_px.description: Overlay card minimum height in pixels. 0 grows automatically with content.

theme.description: Visual style for the overlay. All fields are optional; the server applies per-type defaults for any omitted value. Colors are injected as CSS custom properties on :root.

muted_color.description: Labels and secondary text (e.g. 'Bitrate', 'RTT'). Maps to --muted.

good_color.description: Good / connected signal state. Maps to --good.

warn_color.description: Degraded / warning signal state. Maps to --warn.

bad_color.description: Poor / offline signal state. Maps to --bad.

plot_primary.description: Primary chart line and meter bar color. Use rgba() to control opacity independently of the widget background. Maps to --plot-primary (was --accent).

plot_secondary.description: Secondary chart line or gradient endpoint. Maps to --plot-secondary (was --accent-2).

bg_opacity_good.description: Opacity of the entire overlay when signal is good, including compact-good mode.

bg_opacity_warn.description: Opacity of the entire overlay while signal quality is degraded but not bad.

bg_opacity_bad.description: Opacity of the entire overlay when signal is bad or offline.

border_radius_px.description: Corner rounding of the widget panel in px. Maps to --radius.

backdrop_blur_px.description: CSS backdrop-filter blur in px. 0 disables frosted-glass effect.

font_size_base_px.description: Root font size in px. All widget text scales from this.

connectivity_config.description: Type-specific config for the connectivity/telemetry overlay. Displays selectable live bitrate, RTT, latency, buffer, dropped-packet, uptime, server, meter, and history-chart fields sourced from the SLS stats API.

stream_profile_id.description: SLS player/profile ID whose stats feed this overlay. Stock presets are unbound until selected in the wizard.

poll_ms.description: Stats endpoint polling interval in ms.

bitrate_good_min.description: Bitrate in kbps at or above which signal is GOOD.

bitrate_warn_min.description: Bitrate in kbps at or above which signal is WARN (below = BAD). Must be ≤ bitrate_good_min — enforced by wizard, not schema.

rtt_warn_max.description: RTT in ms at or below which RTT is GOOD. Must be ≤ rtt_bad_max — enforced by wizard, not schema.

rtt_bad_max.description: RTT in ms above which RTT is BAD.

bitrate_meter_max.description: Bitrate in kbps that fills the meter bar to 100%. Set to your target bitrate ceiling.

chart_bitrate_max.description: Bitrate Y-axis ceiling for the history chart. Independent from the meter max.

chart_rtt_max.description: RTT Y-axis ceiling for the history chart.

history_len.description: Number of poll samples kept in the history chart buffers.

bitrate_streak_warn.description: Consecutive polls below bitrate_warn_min required to enter WARN state (hysteresis).

bitrate_streak_bad.description: Consecutive polls below bitrate_warn_min required to enter BAD state (hysteresis).

rtt_streak_warn.description: Consecutive polls above rtt_warn_max required to enter WARN state (hysteresis).

rtt_streak_bad.description: Consecutive polls above rtt_bad_max required to enter BAD state (hysteresis).

use_rtt_in_good.description: When true, both bitrate AND RTT must be good to show the GOOD state. When false, a healthy bitrate alone is enough.

compact_when_good.description: Collapse enabled detail rows when signal is GOOD. Only the status indicator remains visible; the wizard should warn if show_status is false.

show_name.description: Show the stream profile's friendly description. The private stream profile ID is never rendered or sent to the public overlay page.

show_status.description: Show the overall GOOD, WARN, BAD, or NO SIGNAL quality-state indicator.

show_bitrate.description: Show the live bitrate value in kbps.

show_rtt.description: Show the live round-trip-time value in milliseconds.

show_latency.description: Show the fixed-latency row. Intended for bonding setups (e.g. Belabox) that report a separate latency field.

show_buffer.description: Show the live receiver buffer value.

show_meter.description: Show the bitrate progress bar beneath the bitrate value.

show_uptime.description: Show how long the publisher has remained connected.

telemetry_order.description: Display order for movable connectivity telemetry blocks.

telemetry_block_width_px.description: Target width for each telemetry block before the layout wraps.

telemetry_block_height_px.description: Minimum height for each telemetry block.

show_recovery.description: Show packet recovery rate when the telemetry source provides it.

no_signal_behavior.description: What to do when the stats endpoint is unreachable. show_offline = display a clear NO SIGNAL state (per spec §2.0-D). hide = make the widget invisible until stats return.

no_signal_label.description: Text displayed in the show_offline state.

label_style.description: How the status label is rendered. emoji = Unicode glyphs. svg = inline SVG badges with color fill. text = plain words only (most compatible with OBS text capture).

transition_ms.description: CSS transition duration in ms for quality-state changes (background, color). 0 = instant.

upload_progress_config.description: Type-specific config for the upload progress overlay. Shows live FTP/manual upload progress sourced from the /api/uploads/progress endpoint.

active_poll_ms.description: Polling interval in ms while an upload is actively in progress.

idle_poll_ms.description: Polling interval in ms when no upload is in progress. Widget is hidden.

complete_poll_ms.description: Polling interval in ms immediately after upload completes.

complete_hide_ms.description: How long in ms to show the completed state before hiding the widget.

fetch_timeout_ms.description: Abort the progress fetch if the endpoint doesn't respond within this window.

show_sent.description: Show the sent / total bytes row.

latest_photo_config.description: Type-specific config for the latest-photo info overlay. Polls latest.json and displays info about the most recently published image. Requires frame-photo-todaytools capability.

show_filename.description: Show the base filename of the latest photo.

show_thumbnail.description: Show a small thumbnail of the latest photo. Sourced from the FRAME Gallery thumbnail route. Best-effort: no thumbnail shown if the thumb does not yet exist.

thumbnail_size_px.description: Thumbnail display size in pixels (rendered square).

no_photos_behavior.description: What to show when no photos have been published today. hide = widget invisible until first photo. show_empty = widget visible with a waiting state.

no_photos_label.description: Text shown in the show_empty state.

preset.description: A single named overlay configuration. The server resolves GET /overlays/view/<id> → serves the overlay HTML with window.OVERLAY_CONFIG injected from this preset. No query params needed in OBS.

id.description: URL-safe stable identifier. Becomes the path segment in /overlays/view/<id>. Changing this breaks existing OBS browser sources — treat as permanent once set.

name.description: Human display name shown in the wizard and used as the default window_title.

description.description: Optional freetext note. Shown in the wizard preset list.

tags.description: Optional labels for organizing presets in the wizard (e.g. 'minimal', 'portrait', 'full-stats').

enabled.description: Disabled presets return 404 on /overlays/view/<id> and are hidden from the wizard nav. Useful for keeping a config around without surfacing it to OBS.

window_title.description: Custom <title> injected into the overlay page. Defaults to name. Appears in the OBS browser source list — make it distinct so sources are easy to identify.

type.description: Determines which overlay HTML is served and which config shape is expected.

config.description: Type-specific configuration. Shape is determined by 'type'. See connectivity_config, upload_progress_config, latest_photo_config.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp set by the wizard on first save.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp updated by the wizard on every save.
